main_tiers.note: These are the repository release library harnesses, not 11251 independent CLI process runs. The CLI was directly compared for every parent955, maker535 and checker146 case. Ratchet above-baseline differences remain failures, not waived.

guards_before_and_after_review.note: Final post-evidence guard run recorded separately; no guard policy changed.

denominator_notes: 810 is the original campaign cohort, a subset of the parent955, not an additional sample. Parent955 = original810 + 23 class + 41 sequence + 33 theme + 6 registry + 42 TIM cases.

Maker prepared874 omitted 81 parent-only cases; this review measures all955. The maker continuation before was b1bb1cf; our before is parent29642ec6, so maker before counts are intentionally different.
Maker535 includes 22 known valid Teoz failures. All535 were replayed. The 22 failing pairs were byte-copied into standing perturbations and are not counted as new independent inputs.

Checker146 = 118 primary + 28 focused; 24 primary entries across three Teoz mechanisms deliberately share eight source texts to exercise their common dependencies. Unique source SHA counts are reported in the per-input manifests; 146 is a paired-case count, not 146 unique programs.

Ten parent references are invalid: nine trigger the existing error-page classifier; the overflow-date reference is empty and makes historical diff_one exit101. The CLI adapter classifies empty reference as invalid, without changing the comparator or excluding it.
All146 checker references came from pinned raw Java. Two orphan returns are deliberate Java-invalid negative controls and remain failed standing evidence.

All standalone CLI comparisons ran at repo root. The include controls also ran at crates/rustuml-oracle cwd. checker_include_theme passes at root and fails at package cwd; unchanged candidate behavior. No sequence control contains includes.

Built-in suites-before ran955 entries; initial suites-after ran1073 (955+118 primary checker pairs); final evidence-gates ran1123 (955+146+22). Their aggregate failure counts are not a fixed-denominator delta. All before/after comparisons in cohorts use explicit identical manifests.
acceptance: No mechanism is accepted by this review. Some narrowly scoped algebra and parser corrections have positive evidence, but their whole-source dependencies still fail. Passing isolated helpers or subsets cannot waive retained counterexamples.

parent_later_corpus.disposition: Parent owns combined integration replay; no duplicated completed runs.
